titulo.estudio: Les formes dans le texte : Lire l'ensemble
titulo.alumno: Forms in the text: Integrated reading

intro: Use agreement, relative pronouns and verb forms to work out references in a document. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

texto: Use agreement, relative pronouns and verb forms to work out references in a document. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.

Watch out: check the antecedent of the pronoun and the subject of the verb; the written ending can show gender and number even when it is not heard. In this passage, «personnes» means «the last word of the sentence».

frases.estudio: Les dossiers que la commission a reçus hier seront examinés par deux personnes.
frases.alumno: The files that the committee received yesterday will be examined by two people.

frases.estudio: Les membres, dont plusieurs travaillent à distance, se réuniront jeudi matin.
frases.alumno: The members, several of whom work remotely, will meet on Thursday morning.

frases.estudio: La candidate que vous avez appelée a confirmé qu'elle serait disponible.
frases.alumno: The candidate you called has confirmed that she would be available.

frases.estudio: Les résultats seront publiés dès que le comité aura terminé la vérification.
frases.alumno: The results will be published once the committee has finished the verification.
